flashcard_questions.q: What is quality control in a business?
flashcard_questions.a: Inspecting products after they are made to check they meet the required standard.
Building quality into every stage of production so defects are prevented.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the key difference between quality control and quality assurance?
flashcard_questions.a: Control detects defects after production; assurance prevents them during production.
An approach where every employee takes responsibility for quality, aiming for zero defects.
A unique advantage over rivals that is sustainable and difficult to copy.
Communicating with a customer over the lifespan of their purchase.
The support a business gives customers after they have bought a product.

flashcard_questions.q: What advantage does quality control give production workers?
flashcard_questions.a: Specialist inspectors do the checking, so workers can focus on production.

flashcard_questions.q: What is the main waste problem with quality control?
flashcard_questions.a: Faulty products may have gone through the entire production process.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does quality assurance reduce wastage?
flashcard_questions.a: Mistakes are spotted early, before the product is fully made.
